summary: Migration between deployment types is supported only between identical versions (2.6 to 2.6): RPM to containerized, OpenShift or Managed AAP, and containerized to OpenShift or Managed AAP.
questions: Can I migrate from RPM to containerized AAP?
Can I migrate and upgrade at the same time?
Which AAP migration paths are supported in 2.6?

answer_card.title: AAP 2.6 migration paths
answer_card.answer_md:
Same version only (for example 2.6 → 2.6):
- RPM → Containerized, OpenShift, or Managed AAP
- Containerized → OpenShift or Managed AAP
